description: Imports US postal recipients from pasted text, CSV or XLSX into a saved list. Checks required fields and US address format; USPS verification runs only when configured, and usps_checked reports whether it ran. Format checks do not confirm deliverability. Returns list_id, ready counts and row problems. An existing list_id appends recipients, up to 300. Not for email, non-US addresses or advertising to purchased or rented lists.

address_file.description: A CSV or XLSX file the user attached.

addresses_text.description: Addresses as pasted text or CSV. One recipient per line ("Name, Street, City, ST ZIP") or a CSV with a header row.

name: import_address_list
title: Import address list
